description: Generate a comprehensive full-stack code audit report covering all 10 areas: Security, Performance, Deployment Readiness, API Correctness, Chat Pipeline, Content Generation Pipeline, Auth & Authorization, Workflows, Analytics, and SEO/GEO/AEO. The report must reference specific file paths and line numbers.
steps: Create COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_AUDIT.md at the repository root

Section 1 - Security Audit: Analyze hardcoded secrets in .env.shared (JWT_SECRET placeholder), CORS configuration in apps/backend/app/main.py and apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts, JWT handling in apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py and apps/edge/src/middleware/jwt.ts, input sanitization in apps/backend/app/core/security.py, rate limiting in apps/backend/app/core/rate_limiter.py and apps/edge/src/middleware/rate-limit.ts, admin auth in apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin.py, webhook signature verification in apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, SSRF protection in security.py

Section 2 - Performance Audit: Analyze connection pooling in apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py (motor pool), embedder.py creating new httpx client per request, Azure Search using sync client in thread pool (azure_search.py), gunicorn worker config (gunicorn_conf.py), streaming implementation in chat.py, cold start with all Optional config

Section 3 - Deployment Readiness: Analyze Dockerfile multi-stage build, CI/CD in .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml, health checks in apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py vs container-app.bicep probes, env var completeness comparing .env.shared to config.py, rollback strategy (or lack thereof), concurrency settings in deploy workflow

Section 4 - API Correctness: Analyze route coverage in main.py router registration, request validation in chat.py/auth.py pydantic models, error handling patterns (generic 500 catch-all in chat), HTTP status codes, API versioning (v1 prefix), OpenAPI auto-generation

Section 5 - Chat Pipeline: Analyze message flow from edge (index.ts) through proxy (api-proxy.ts) to backend (chat.py), streaming SSE implementation, context management (no conversation history in prompt), token limits (maxOutputTokens hardcoded), error recovery (Sarvam->Vertex fallback), dead letter queue

Section 6 - Content Generation Pipeline: Analyze RAG implementation in azure_search.py (hybrid BM25+vector+semantic), embedding generation in embedder.py, search relevance (k=50 candidates, tier filtering), prompt engineering in chat.py (_build_system_prompt), language detection in router.py (Unicode range detection), response quality controls

Section 7 - Auth & Authorization: Analyze JWT lifecycle (access + refresh tokens in auth.py), token refresh endpoint, session management (stateless JWT), role-based access (admin.py cookie-based), middleware chain (edge JWT -> backend auth dependency), optional auth for chat

Section 8 - Workflows: Analyze Razorpay payment flow (subscription.py + razorpay_client.py + webhook), email flows in resend_client.py, subscription lifecycle management, webhook idempotency (or lack thereof), payment.failed handling

Section 9 - Analytics: Analyze PostHog integration in main.py and frontend index.html, Sentry error reporting setup, OpenTelemetry tracing in telemetry.py, structured logging in request middleware, feedback collection in feedback.py

Section 10 - SEO/GEO/AEO: Analyze meta tags and structured data in apps/frontend/index.html, robots.txt policy, manifest.json PWA config, llms.txt and ai.txt for AEO, geographic optimization (India regions in Bicep, content-language meta), sitemap strategy
For each section, categorize findings as CRITICAL (must fix before production), WARNING (should fix soon), or RECOMMENDATION (nice to have), with specific file:line references
acceptance_criteria: Report covers all 10 audit areas with dedicated sections
All findings reference specific file paths and line numbers where applicable
Report includes an executive summary with total counts of issues by severity
Report is well-structured markdown with table of contents
verification: Confirm COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_AUDIT.md exists and is non-empty
Confirm the file has sections for all 10 audit areas
Confirm findings reference actual files that exist in the codebase
